title: QUBIVEX model manifest
description: manifest.json, schema 1.1 (ADR-004). A minor version adds optional fields; `qubivex models migrate` moves a manifest forward, and a build refuses a newer minor. Dimensions are read from config.json or GGUF metadata, not from here; the manifest only names files and supplies what the checkpoint does not declare.

relpath.description: Relative to the model directory; no '..', no absolute or drive paths, no backslashes.

size.description: A shard's is checked against the file at load.

schema_version.description: This build reads 1.0 and 1.1, and writes 1.1. `source` and `files` need 1.1.

id.description: Stable id used on the command line.

source.description: Where the model came from (schema 1.1). Provider-neutral; nothing that runs a model reads it.

revision.description: The exact revision, not a branch.

id.description: A registered architecture, for example transformer_moe.

version.description: Accepted when the major matches and the minor is not newer than the build's.

config.description: Architecture-specific options. For transformer_moe: tensor_names ("hf" | "hf_fused" | "gguf" | {"base": preset, <name>: pattern with {L} and {E}}), qk_norm ("none" | "full" | "per_head"), router_scoring ("softmax" | "sigmoid").
config.json (SafeTensors only; GGUF carries its config).

files.description: The model's other files, such as config and tokenizer, for their checksums (schema 1.1).

context_length.description: A lower limit than the architecture's.

config.description: Values missing from config.json or GGUF metadata, by config.json name. A value the checkpoint also states must agree with it.
